title: Restore the beyond-cut and wrong-source evaluation admission checks across service and MCP on source_id checks
outcome: Restore the beyond-cut and wrong-source evaluation admission checks across service and MCP on source_id checks
acceptance: The cross-transport admission test in src/mcp/tests.rs covers the beyond_cut and wrong_source citation causes again, built on checks installed with a source_id basis, and for wrong_source asserts that the service and MCP refusals name the same citable record in details.cause.citable_records and in the first 512 bytes of the message.
